n8n-app.html.title: grvpanchal n8n - Google Integration App
n8n-app.html.text: ← Back to Home grvpanchal n8n Google Verified Secure Google authentication for workflow automation powered by n8n What is grvpanchal n8n? grvpanchal n8n is a workflow automation application built by Gaurav Panchal using n8n , an open-source automation platform. It provides secure Google OAuth 2.0 authentication to connect with Google services and automate tasks across multiple Google products. The app allows authorized users to authenticate with their Google account so that n8n workflows can securely read and interact with Google services on their behalf. Google Services We Access When you authenticate with grvpanchal n8n , the app may request access to the following Google services based on the workflows you use: Google Sheets Read and write spreadsheet data to automate data collection, reporting, and tracking workflows. Gmail Read emails and send automated messages for notification, communication, and email-based workflows. Google Drive Access, organize, and manage files in Google Drive for file-based automation workflows. Blogger Read and publish blog posts to automate content management and publishing workflows. How It Works Sign in with Google — You authenticate securely using Google OAuth 2.0. We never see or store your Google password. Authorize access — You review and approve the specific Google services the app needs to access. Workflows run securely — n8n uses your authorized credentials to execute automation workflows on your behalf. Revoke anytime — You can revoke access at any time from your Google Account Permissions . Data & Privacy We only request the minimum permissions (scopes) needed for each workflow. Your Google data is processed only within the n8n automation workflows you authorize. We do not sell, share, or use your data for advertising. Our use of Google data adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy , including the Limited Use requirements. Read our full Privacy Policy for details. Who Can Use This? This app is intended for authorized users invited by Gaurav Panchal to use the n8n automation setup. If you have been given access, you can sign in with your Google account to enable automated workflows. Security All connections use HTTPS encryption. OAuth 2.0 tokens are stored securely within the n8n instance and are never exposed publicly. The n8n instance is self-hosted and managed by Gaurav Panchal. Access is restricted to invited users only. Contact If you have questions about grvpanchal n8n or need support, please reach out: Website: grvpanchal.me GitHub: github.com/grvpanchal Home · Privacy Policy · Terms of Service

privacy.html.text: ← Back to Home Privacy Policy Effective Date: April 1, 2026 This Privacy Policy describes how grvpanchal n8n and grvpanchal.me ("Site"), operated by Gaurav Panchal ("we", "us", or "our"), collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our Site and services, including the grvpanchal n8n workflow automation app that uses Google account authentication to access Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Drive, and Blogger. 1. Information We Collect a) Information from Google Authentication When you sign in with your Google account, we may receive: Your name Email address Profile picture URL Google account ID We only request the minimum scopes necessary for the service to function. We do not access your Google password, contacts, or other data beyond what you explicitly authorize. b) Information You Provide If you use our contact form or other interactive features, we may collect your name, email address, and message content. c) Automatically Collected Information We may automatically collect: IP address Browser type and version Device type and operating system Pages visited and time spent Referring URL This data is collected through Google Analytics and standard server logs. 2. How We Use Your Information We use the collected information to: Authenticate your identity and provide access to services Personalize your experience Respond to your inquiries and messages Improve our Site and services Monitor usage and analytics Comply with legal obligations 3. Data Sharing & Disclosure We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share data only in the following circumstances: Service Providers: Third-party tools (e.g., Google Analytics, hosting providers) that help us operate the Site, bound by their own privacy policies. Legal Requirements: If required by law, regulation, or legal process. Protection: To protect our rights, safety, or property, or that of our users. 4. Google API Services — Limited Use Disclosure Our use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy , including the Limited Use requirements. Specifically, we only use Google user data for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy and do not use it for serving advertisements. We do not allow humans to read your data unless we have your affirmative consent, it is necessary for security purposes, or it is required by law. 5. Data Storage & Security We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security. Data is transmitted over HTTPS (encrypted connection). Authentication tokens are handled securely and are not stored in plain text. We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide the services or as required by law. 6. Cookies & Tracking We use cookies and similar technologies for: Essential cookies: To maintain your authentication session. Analytics cookies: Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our Site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but some features of the Site may not function properly without them. 7. Your Rights You have the right to: Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal retention requirements. Revoke Access: Revoke our access to your Google account at any time via your Google Account Permissions page. Opt-Out: Opt out of analytics tracking by using browser extensions such as the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on . 8. Children's Privacy Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected data from a child under 13, we will delete it promptly. 9. Third-Party Links Our Site may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information. 10. Changes to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. Your continued use of the services after the changes take effect constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy. 11. workflows/index.html.text: ← Gaurav Panchal Evolution Framework Workflows The 14 n8n routines (Start + End per pillar) that power the Evolution Framework. Import any of them into your own n8n. Take the 7-pillar self-assessment → CEO Routine Routine Start CEO Start — Personal Peak Performance Morning body-mind check. Routes the goal you start to a running coach (today's easy-jog pace from recent Strava runs), a lifting analyst (session plan from your Jefit history) or a mindfulness guide (a short intention practice). Strava Jefit OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CEO End — Personal Peak Performance End-of-day review for run, lift and meditation goals. AI reviewers grade today against this week's training load (pace, heart rate, muscle split, practice type) and return an HTML scorecard as the goal reward. Strava Jefit OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON COO Routine Routine Start COO Start — Daily Operating Rhythm Opens the day. A define agent sets the intention and governing principles; a plan agent turns them into a time-blocked plan with focus levels and success criteria. OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON Routine End COO End — Daily Operating Rhythm Closes each operating step: materialises ticked plan items into day tasks, writes the office-work wrap from what you completed, publishes a morning principles blog with outfit images from your "fit" selfie, and renders the nightly reflect dashboard. Telegram Google Drive Blogger Chess.com OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON CTO Routine Routine Start CTO Start — Technical Quality & Delivery Technical-leverage kickoff. Tech, delivery and skills agents give a ranked certification/stack plan, the day's biggest delivery time-sink and quality risk, and the one skill to sharpen. Perplexity Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CTO End — Technical Quality & Delivery Technical-leverage close-out. The same tech, delivery and skills agents reflect on what shipped and set the next concrete step. Perplexity Import to n8n View JSON CIO Routine Routine Start CIO Start - Leverage Building Leverage audit grounded in real numbers: social and LinkedIn analytics, blog and site traffic, job pipeline, collaborators and certifications. Media, labour, capital and tech agents each recommend where to build leverage today. Google Analytics Google Sheets LinkedIn Upload-Post Perplexity Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CIO End — Leverage Building Leverage close-out. Labour, media and capital agents reflect on delegation, reach and brand-valuation progress, and close the loop on the routine. Perplexity Import to n8n View JSON CFO Routine Routine Start CFO Start — Financial Guardrails Financial guardrails for the day. Reads your portfolio statement and last three months of spending, then a coach working through the Five Levels of Financial Freedom adds concrete actions as subtasks and logs your trajectory. Google Sheets OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CFO End — Financial Guardrails Evaluates the day's financial actions against your portfolio and spending data, tracks progress toward the next level of financial freedom, and returns an HTML report as the reward. Google Sheets OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON CXO Routine Routine Start CXO Start - Response Desk Response desk. Summarises the day's WhatsApp, Instagram and LinkedIn messages, then drafts empathetic, value-adding replies to unread Gmail (saved as drafts, never sent) and logs a daily messaging summary. WhatsApp Instagram LinkedIn Gmail Google Sheets OpenRouter Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CXO End — Contribution & Service Contribution and service close-out. Empathize, ideate and implement agents reflect on the people you served today and propose kind, concrete follow-ups. Perplexity Import to n8n View JSON CMO Routine Routine Start CMO Start - Campaign Planner Campaign planner. Researches real statistics on the topic, writes a flagship blog post and hero image, scripts channel-specific versions (explainer video, reels, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok) and creates them as subtasks. Perplexity OpenRouter Google Drive Google Sheets Import to n8n View JSON Routine End CMO End - Campaign Publisher Campaign publisher. Posts the approved campaign to Blogger and social channels, dispatches the video formats, then projects performance from prior social analytics and reports it as the reward.
